name: Cosmoctopus

categories.label: All players gained 8 tentacles before the Private Investigator
categories.labelVi: Tất cả người chơi đủ 8 xúc tu trước Thám tử
categories.hint: Team wins only if every player reaches 8 tentacles before the PI does.

categories.label: Private Investigator tentacles (progress tracker)
categories.labelVi: Xúc tu của Thám tử (thanh tiến độ)
categories.hint: PI gains 1 tentacle at 8 of a resource, or 2 plus Forbidden Knowledge at 13. PI wins at 8.

endCondition.description: PI wins by reaching 8 tentacles first; players win when each of them has gained 8 tentacles.

winCondition: Every player must gain 8 tentacles before the Private Investigator does; if the PI reaches 8 first, everyone loses.
notes: family: coop. Solo play uses the same PI rules. PI difficulty by starting resources: Naive 1, Tenacious 2, Relentless 3, Obsessive 5 of each type. Each player who reaches 8 leaves play and donates their Move bonus to others.

sources.title: Cosmoctopus official rulebook EN (Paper Fort Games / Lucky Duck)
sources.section: p.8 Gaining Tentacles; p.9 Winning the Game; p.12 express game
